data.body: **[P1] Latch suspension/termination before the handler can settle `body`.** `runUntilCompleteOrSuspend` uses `anyOf` and then checks `body.isDone()`, while manager suspension/termination currently completes operation futures before its execution-failure future. A quickly throwing handler `finally` can therefore win this race, changing an already-triggered `PENDING`/`RETRYING` outcome into terminal `FAILED`. Publish a tagged manager outcome before waking operation waiters, and add a natural step/wait-for-condition suspension test whose `finally` immediately throws.
